author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Conway's law says organizations which design systems are constrained to produce designs which are copies of the communication structure of these organizations.
Jack Dorsey says companies will operate by acting as an "intelligence layer" that completely replaces traditional middle management.
If we combine Conway + Dorsey, the future of any software system is just a giant AI sitting in the middle with lots of agent skills on the peripheral.
